# Read this section before submitting

* Make sure that your PR follows the [External Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/leanprover/vscode-lean4/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
* Make sure that the PR has excellent documentation and tests.
* Include the link to your `RFC` or `bug` issue in the description.
* If the issue does not already have approval from a maintainer, submit the PR as draft.
* The PR title/description will become the commit message. Keep it up-to-date as the PR evolves. The PR title will also become the entry in the release notes.
* CI builds the extension for each PR. To test the build, open the run of the `vscode-lean4 build` workflow and download the `vscode-lean4` artifact. Unzip it and install the `.vsix` file with the command **Extensions: Install from VSIX...**.
* Remove this section, up to and including the `---` before submitting.

---

This PR <summary of the change and the reason for it>.

Closes <`RFC` or `bug` issue number fixed by this PR, if any>
